name: Formicapunk
summary: A Brazilian favela aesthetic celebrating resourcefulness, vibrant colors, and community resilience in the face of economic hardship.
description: Formicapunk is a Brazilian aesthetic rooted in favela culture, celebrating resourcefulness, vibrant colors, and community resilience. The term references the formica (laminate) surfaces common in favela construction, reclaimed and transformed into something beautiful. The aesthetic encompasses the visual culture of Brazilian favelas, including their architecture, fashion, music, and art.
